purpose: Audit whether the independent USGS St. Croix data release supports a direct external hydrology test of frog calling, without using NAAMP-derived soil moisture.

focal_system.calling_measure: Daily 21:00-23:00 integrated sound intensity in the species-specific 2900-3200 Hz band.
focal_system.hydrology_measure: Median daily wetland water depth from pressure logger.

eligibility_gates: Calling file exposes an explicit calendar date and numeric calling-activity value for SC4DAI2.
Water-depth file exposes SiteID, calendar date and numeric median daily water depth.
The two sources overlap on >=100 daily dates across >=3 distinct years.
Zero/no-calling days are represented within the potential calling season, rather than the file containing only positive call days.
No outcome-dependent file or column choice is required.

if_eligible_analysis_to_freeze_after_sch.primary_question: Within the known annual calling season, is daily calling activity higher when measured wetland water depth is greater, after controlling flexibly for year and within-year seasonal progression?
covariates: within-year day-of-season quadratic or spline chosen before endpoint values are inspected
if_eligible_analysis_to_freeze_after_sch.covariance: HAC/Newey-West or year-clustered sensitivity because daily observations are temporally autocorrelated.
if_eligible_analysis_to_freeze_after_sch.secondary: Compare days with surface water depth >0 versus <=0 only if zero-depth days are genuinely represented.

interpretation_boundaries: This is a single-species, single-wetland direct-hydrology replication, not a replication of NAAMP matrix geometry.
Water depth is a breeding-habitat state, not frog body hydration.
Observational association does not prove causal mediation.
No RC11 submission change is authorized.
